commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is booked by the referee.

90+2' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
90+1' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+1' The attendance is 74170.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
86' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Jude Bellingham and he is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
85' Substitution. Pacha makes his way off the pitch and Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as his replacement.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pathe Ciss departs the field of play to be replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
85' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is given a yellow card.
81' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid will take a free kick.
80' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
79' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is the one who receives a yellow card.
79' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
79' The substitution has been made. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has replaced Kylian Mbappe.
78' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

76' CHANCE! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Luka Modric. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
75' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot.
74' Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Adrian Embarba can be given a rest.
70' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pedro Diaz is replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
70' It's time for a substitution. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Gerard Gumbau.
70' The referee blows his whistle as Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
68' The substitution is prepared. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrygo.
67' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
66' The game is interrupted as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is flagged offside.
63' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
62' The ball is behind the touchline and Real Madrid will take a throw-in.
61' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
61' Real Madrid are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
58' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid). Rayo Vallecano win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
57' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits a rough challenge. Francisco Maeso blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Real Madrid get a free kick.

55' Close! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
54' Dangerous play by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid have been awarded a free kick.

51' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
46' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid). There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) rips a bullet of a shot from mid-range that goes in off the crossbar, leaving the keeper without any chance.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid).
45' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
44' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' The game is interrupted now, Rodrygo (Real Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
42' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
40' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
36' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Augusto Batalla with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

34' 2 - 0 A great individual effort by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid)! Showcasing his skills, he found his way deep inside the box and produced a low drive which goes straight into the middle of the net. Absolutely amazing!
33' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

32' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Andriy Lunin, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
30' 1 - 0 Goal Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid)! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was put through by Vinicius Junior and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
29' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.

28' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate at all and the ball went way wide of the right post. What a miss that is! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
27' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.

27' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.

26' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francisco Maeso with no other option than to blow for a foul. Real Madrid have a free kick.
25' The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
23' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) takes it short.
22' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
20' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
18' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) heads on.
16' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Augusto Batalla shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!

15' What a great touch by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post.

13' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' The ball has crossed the sideline. Real Madrid are taking a throw-in.
11' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
9' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

9' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
7' Corner kick. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to send the ball into the box.

7' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
7' 61:39 – the ratio of ball possession.
6' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.
6' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Real Madrid.
4' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francisco Maeso saw the whole situation. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick.
3' Real Madrid keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
2' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
